article_title: NuGet 包分发 agent skill 的取用与成本
core_theme: NuGet 包可以携带 agent skill，dotnet restore 会把它下载到仓库之外的全局包缓存，需要工具把副本搬进仓库，agent 才读得到；skill 同时带来 token 成本。
reader_takeaway: 理解 skill 从包到 agent 的搬运路径，知道它默认落在哪里、为什么要复制一份进仓库，以及为什么 skill 会带来额外 token 成本。
summary_angle: 包裹里的 skill 文档先落在共享缓存，再由搬运者把一份副本送进仓库的阅读间；节点越往右越接近真正读它的地方。

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文 markout 包的 skills/*/SKILL.md 列表与 ~/.nuget/packages 下的 find 输出，说明 skill 随包发布
information_blocks.visual_idea: 左侧深色货架上，一个像素风格的包裹木箱里立着几张薄薄的卡片，表示包内携带 skill 文档

information_blocks.source_anchor: dotnet-package-skills README：全局包缓存在 ~/.nuget/packages，位于仓库之外，机器上所有项目共用

final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes an article about shipping agent skills inside NuGet packages. Theme: a package crate carries thin SKILL.md documents, they land in a shared storage hall outside the repository, and a courier carries one copy into the repository room where an agent can read it. The reader should quickly feel the three-stage journey from package to reading desk, and that the copy is deliberate.
Summary angle: A package carries skill documents; they land in a shared cache outside the repo; a copy is carried into the repo's reading room; that extra copy is the price of the capability.
Narrative flow: 3-beat process, left to right across a 2.35:1 frame, with one dominant focal subject and three supporting narrative beats.
Information blocks:
- mechanism: a pixel-art wooden package crate on a dark warehouse shelf, several thin cards standing inside it, small tag reading 包
- contrast: a wide shared storage hall separated from a smaller repository room by a doorway; the doorway is the boundary; small tag reading 缓存 on the hall side
- step: a flat pixel courier carries one card through the doorway toward an empty reading desk in the repository room; small tag reading 仓库
Main metaphor: a courier carrying one skill card from a shared warehouse into a private reading room.
Subject: a small flat 2D pixel-art courier holding a single thin card with both hands, mid-stride through the doorway.
Composition/framing: slightly elevated three-quarter view; diagonal left-to-right movement; a foreground shelf frames the left edge, the doorway sits in the middle ground as the boundary, the repository room with a plain reading desk occupies the right background; keep the courier, the card and the doorway sharp.
Scene integration: the courier stays a flat pixel sprite with a crisp stepped silhouette and deliberate pixel clusters; the crate, shelves, floor, doorway and room have real 3D volume and stylized pixel-textured surfaces with correct perspective and occlusion; contact shadows under the crate, shelves, desk and courier; one warm amber side light from the left rakes across all three zones and a dimmer cool light in the repository room separates it from the warehouse.
Style/medium: combine product-poster style illustration with this selected visual style descriptor: 2D pixel-art subjects with crisp stepped silhouettes and deliberate pixel clusters, integrated into a volumetric 3D environment with stylized pixel-textured surfaces, coherent perspective and foreground-midground-background depth, shared directional lighting and grounded contact/cast shadows, a sharp focal plane with restrained depth of field where helpful, controlled highlights and subtle atmospheric separation, a scene-specific palette, readable at thumbnail size; no voxel-built characters, no smooth plastic figurines, no full-frame mosaic filter, no excessive bloom or blur. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: deep teal shadows, warm amber light, muted cream cards, slate floor; four colors total, one warm accent.
Visible text policy: allow only two tiny Chinese labels 包 and 仓库 on small unobtrusive tags, no more than two; if characters risk rendering poorly, omit them entirely rather than substituting English. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names, no fabricated numbers.
Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.
Avoid: floating chips, code rain, neon cityscape, generic robot pose, cyberpunk purple-blue glow, heavy HUD overlays, plastic toy figures, voxel-built characters, full-frame pixelation, excessive bloom or blur.
